#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    vector<int> beauty(n);
    int totalBeauty = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> beauty[i];
        totalBeauty += beauty[i];
    }

    vector<int> equalPairs;
    vector<int> charOccurrencesInEqualPairs(128, 0);
    char mostCommonCharInEqualPairs = 'a';

    // Finding all pairs with s[i] == s[n - 1 - i]
    for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; ++i) {
        if (s[i] == s[n - 1 - i]) {
            equalPairs.push_back(i);
            int chIndex = s[i];
            if (++charOccurrencesInEqualPairs[chIndex] > charOccurrencesInEqualPairs[mostCommonCharInEqualPairs]) {
                mostCommonCharInEqualPairs = s[i];
            }
        }
    }

    int ans = totalBeauty;
    for (int equalPair : equalPairs) {
        ans -= min(beauty[equalPair], beauty[n - 1 - equalPair]);
    }

    if (charOccurrencesInEqualPairs[mostCommonCharInEqualPairs] > (int(equalPairs.size()) / 2)) {
        vector<int> nonEqualPairsMinBeautyPenalties;
        for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; ++i) {
            if (s[i] != s[n - 1 - i] &&
                s[i] != mostCommonCharInEqualPairs &&
                s[n - 1 - i] != mostCommonCharInEqualPairs) {
                nonEqualPairsMinBeautyPenalties.push_back(
                    min(beauty[i], beauty[n - 1 - i]));
            }
        }
        sort(nonEqualPairsMinBeautyPenalties);
        int rem = 2 * charOccurrencesInEqualPairs[mostCommonCharInEqualPairs] - (int(equalPairs.size()));
        for (int i = 0; i < rem && i < (int)nonEqualPairsMinBeautyPenalties.size(); ++i) {
            ans -= nonEqualPairsMinBeautyPenalties[i];
        }
    }

    cout << ans << "\n";

    return 0;
}
